en.title: Minimum Insertions to Make a Parenthesis String Valid
en.description:
Only insertions of parentheses are allowed. Find the minimum number of insertions needed to turn the original string into a valid parenthesis string.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and solution; bounds missing from the source and corrections to the examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: One line containing a string of only ( and ), with full original bounds 1≤length≤100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The three examples need 2, 4, and 0 insertions respectively. The second can become (())(()); the source's (()))(()) is wrong in both length and validity and has been corrected.
hints: While scanning, keep a balance of unmatched left parentheses. When a right parenthesis arrives and the balance is 0, a left parenthesis must be inserted; at the end, insert a right parenthesis for each remaining left parenthesis.
